verdict.rationale: Speech-to-text products can plausibly offer AI insights such as summaries or analysis of transcribed audio, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents transcription, translation, and language identification, with no in-product insights or suggestions generated from user data. Transcription output is the core function, not an insights capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
